## Delivery procedure

Follow `AGENTS.md` and `docs/contributing.md`, Project delivery. Read the parent and dependency outcomes, recheck current `main`, record a plan and active branch, and use TDD. The PR owns verification evidence. Leave a concise outcome and refresh downstream context after authorized merge; opening a PR does not authorize merging it.
